children.value: > Fact From Story | Concerns surrounding FTX’s liquidity grew after CoinDesk published a copy of Alameda’s balance sheet, showing the firm held $14.6 billion in assets and $8 billion in liabilities as of June 30, 2022.
> > Fact From Story | The report showed Alameda’s largest asset was $3.66 billion of “unlocked FTT” and $2.16 billion of “FTT collateral.”
> > > Fact From Story | The balance sheet showed that the $5.82 billion in FTT tokens that Alameda owned was 193% higher than the total FTT market cap, which was about $3 billion at the time.
> > > Fact From Story | FTT was the token behind FTX.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge | A company's own token is not a reliable asset on its balance sheet.
> > Commonsense Knowledge | If a company's assets are mostly in its own cryptocurrency, then its assets are not very liquid.
> Commonsense Knowledge | A bank run can cause a company to file for bankruptcy.
